name: Transition Issue
description: Performs an issue transition and, if the transition has a screen, updates the fields from the transition screen. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-transitions-post)

configurable_props.name: issueIdOrKey
configurable_props.label: Issue ID or Key
configurable_props.description: The ID or key of an issue

configurable_props.name: transition
configurable_props.label: Transition
configurable_props.description: Details of a transition. Required when performing a transition, optional when creating or editing an issue, See `Transition` section of [doc](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-put). Also you can go edit the workflow and choose the Text option instead of the Diagram option. You can see the transition ID in parenthesis.

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description: List of issue screen fields to update, specifying the sub-field to update and its value for each field. This field provides a straightforward option when setting a sub-field. When multiple sub-fields or other operations are required, use `update`. Fields included in here cannot be included in `update`. (.i.e for Fields "fields": {"summary":"Completed orders still displaying in pending","customfield_10010":1,}) [see doc](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-put)

configurable_props.name: update
configurable_props.label: Update
configurable_props.description: List of operations to perform on issue screen fields. Note that fields included here cannot be included in fields.

configurable_props.name: historyMetadata
configurable_props.label: History Metadata
configurable_props.description: Additional issue history details. See `HistoryMetadata` section of [doc](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-transitions-post)

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: Details of issue properties to be add or update

configurable_props.name: additionalProperties
configurable_props.label: Additional Properties
configurable_props.description: Extra properties of any type may be provided to this object
